stage: trunk fragment (B piece: middle third of anterior zooid)

injury: two transverse cuts isolating one third of the anterior zooid (A, B or C level); head and posterior zooid discarded

intervention.description: posterior third of first zooid (C piece) dropped into chloral hydrate solution (mol. 1/165) as soon as cut, exposed 24 hours, then washed and returned to water for the rest of 14 days

notes: Paper gives per-flask percentages of 50 pieces (methods: each flask received fifty pieces); percentages include the DEAD column and each flask sums to 100 within rounding; converted to counts as pct/2 and summed over 1 flask(s). Breakdown (counts): normal 43, teratophthalmic 5, teratomorphic 1, anophthalmic 1, headless (acephalic, no anterior regeneration) 0, dead 0. 'other' = teratophthalmic + teratomorphic + anophthalmic (Child's classes of incomplete heads: eye reductions/single median eye, reduced head with median eye, anterior regeneration without eyes). Lab field set per task instruction (Child laboratory, Hull Zoological Laboratory, Chicago); sole author Buchanan. Concentration stated as mol. 1/165 (approximate per methods); dose given as 6.0606 mM. Agent is a general anesthetic/narcotic; no molecular target stated, action left null.
